question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is '**inseparable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the deep and enduring friendship between Sudama and Krishna. 
 
• The appropriate adjective should indicate a bond that is extremely close and unbreakable. 
 
• "**Inseparable**" fits well as it denotes a relationship that cannot easily be separated, aligning with the context of Sudama and Krishna's friendship. 
 
• Other options ("**irrevocable**", "**inked**", "**insignificant**") do not fit the context of describing such a deep friendship bond. 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: * The two, Sudama and Krishna, were (1) **inseparable**__. To date, their oneness is an example of true friendship ahead of the planet. This is often the rationale why they are remembered (2) _______ the auspicious day of Friendship. Even after losing touch for several years after finishing their studies together, they did not (3) _______ the hope of meeting again. Sudama always had lord Krishna in his heart and soul and kept (4) _______ of him until they met again. The entire incident when Sudama met Krishna after numerous years is so (5) _______ and unforgettable. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Irrevocable **(अपरिवर्तनीय): "Irrevocable" means not able to be changed, reversed, or recovered. Though it indicates permanence, it does not capture the closeness of friendship. 
 
• **Inked **(स्याही): "Inked" means marked or written with ink, which does not fit the context of describing a deep, personal relationship. 
 
• **Insignificant **(मामूली): "Insignificant" means too small or unimportant to be worth consideration, which is the opposite of describing a close bond.
